insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Azir is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Azir in 55/129 games (43%): 10 picks (5-5) and 45 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ambessa? They go Rumble
insights.text: Ambessa is a G1 favorite (10/45 G1s, played by Siwoo). In the 55 later games where it was burned or banned, Siwoo went to Rumble (7/55) and Jax (6/55).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 39 G3+ games, 66/195 picks (34%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 62 champs in G1s, 82 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned
